source_package.name: cross-domain CREP inversion (10 packages)
source_package.ported_note: Each domain's eta/sigma/gamma is copied from that package's own constants.py, not recomputed independently.

framework_overlay.note: This app's entire purpose is comparing published Γ values across packages; framed explicitly in-app as a comparison coordinate system, not a universal physical constant.

cross_app_relations.detail: amoc.eta/gammaPublished are copied from amoc-utac, the same package amoc-kipppunkt ports.
amazon.eta/gammaPublished are copied from amazon-utac, the same package amazon-kipppunkt ports.

disclaimer: Vergleichs-Koordinatensystem, keine universelle physikalische Konstante. Jeder Wert stammt aus dem jeweiligen Quellpaket.
